verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an official MCP server in a dedicated help article, confirmed by probe. The article describes an AI assistant working inside the workspace within user-set limits and with configurable permissions. Documented tools include listing audits and evidence requests and adding comments, attachments, and status updates, along with example prompts. Missing for 10: connection/auth setup details and supported client list in evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
